meta.title: Suggestion register — proposed improvements awaiting human review
meta.rule: NOTHING in this file is implemented. Each suggestion is a proposal; a reviewer sets status (proposed → under_review → accepted | rejected | deferred) and decision notes. Implementation begins only after acceptance, in a separate change.
review_protocol: 1. Reviewer reads the suggestion + linked question(s).
2. Reviewer checks the discovery suggestion and any prerequisites are satisfiable.
3. Reviewer sets status and records decision + date in the review UI (or by PR comment).
4. Accepted suggestions become tasks on COORDINATION.md with explicit file scope.
5. Rejected/deferred stay in the register for audit; never silently deleted.

suggestions.title: Ingest official NFL depth charts (skill + OL + front 7) weekly
suggestions.description: The injury report lists practice status but not starter/backup identity. Official 2026 depth charts would let the tracker map any DNP starter to the actual 2nd/3rd/4th-string replacement and rate unit deficiency (e.g., CB#2 vs nickel package).
prereqs: Confirm nfl.com depth-chart URL pattern stability for 2026

suggestions.title: License/ingest a verifiable historical odds archive
suggestions.description: Without a time-stamped line archive, no strategy can pass G7 (market comparison) and leaderboard edge is unmeasurable. Evaluate licensed feeds (e.g., Sportradar — the NFL's official betting-data distributor) or a documented, permitted archive; record cost and terms.

suggestions.title: Official player game logs for prop-combo correlation
suggestions.description: Prop-pair correlations (e.g., QB yds × team total) are currently BLANK. Official play-by-play/game logs would enable joint distributions, correlation measurement with 95% CIs, and S6 pricing.
prereqs: Choose official endpoint (nfl.com stats / league feed); confirm permitted use

suggestions.title: Automated weekly re-verification pipeline
suggestions.description: GitHub Action (or scheduled job) that re-fetches the 3 official pages, diffs against the last snapshot, re-runs consistency gate and link checker, and fails loudly on drift (e.g., standings corrections, moved URLs).
prereqs: Approve automation; confirm polite fetch cadence

suggestions.title: Walk-forward backtest harness across 2016–2026 seasons
suggestions.description: n=136 graded games cannot support luck removal at n≥300. Backtesting the registered strategies on a full decade (with season-by-season holdout) would produce the graded sample G3 requires and true Brier/ECE.
prereqs: Licensed or permitted historical data (not scraped against terms)
Registered backtest protocol in registry before running

suggestions.title: Injury-adjusted model as a separate registered strategy, not a manual tweak
suggestions.description: S4 is currently blocked because manual adjustment violates the no-manual-input rule. Automate: map DNP→replacement via depth chart (SUG-01), apply pre-registered position-level replacement deltas fitted on history, register S4' before evaluation.
prereqs: SUG-05 accepted (needs history to fit deltas)

suggestions.title: Rewards governance: define budget, payout rule, compliance sign-off before any leaderboard pays
suggestions.description: Leaderboard v1.0 awards virtual-only points. Any real reward needs: funded budget, eligibility = all G-pass, anti-collusion rules, problem-gambling guardrails, and counsel review.

suggestions.title: Canonical root navigation decision
suggestions.description: The repo carries multiple parallel dashboards (nfl/, nfl-lab/, nfl-quant/, nfl-research/, nba-evidence/, rental-*). Choose ONE canonical entry point per domain (or a single index) and archive the rest; root rebuild is locked by the canonical NBA workflow — coordinate with its owner before editing root index.html.

suggestions.title: Decision journal page: questions → suggestions → acceptance → outcome
suggestions.description: Extend this namespace with a running journal that links each accepted suggestion to the commit/PR that implemented it and its measured outcome, closing the loop for 'choose the best path before implementing'.

suggestions.title: Rest/travel/weather features from official sources
suggestions.description: S7 needs rest days (derivable from official schedule), travel miles and game-time weather (official feeds exist for international games). Would make rest/travel a testable signal rather than a registered-but-idle hypothesis.
prereqs: Confirm official weather/altitude feed; define inclusion rule in registry

suggestions.title: Row-level provenance linter for every table in the repo
suggestions.description: Extend nfl-intel's verify_site.py into a repo-wide check: any <tr> without a source link fails CI. Would have caught peer rows lacking sources automatically.
prereqs: Adopt in CI; allow-list legacy namespaces initially

suggestions.title: Correlation regime monitor (rolling 60-game team-stat correlations)
suggestions.description: Team correlations (net_ppg vs pct r=0.876) are season-to-date and will drift. A rolling, FDR-controlled monitor would flag when a signal's correlation decays before the market adapts — useful for strategy retirement.
